reference.description: Nominal D405 640x360 color stream. Replace with measured D405 intrinsics if available.

notes: Raw is the recommended mode for the rigid-pose-optimized mount: the D435i RGB array is passed through unchanged.
Set image_transform to crop_resize only to reproduce the older single-plane crop experiment.
In crop_resize mode, the server queries each D435i factory color intrinsic at 640x360 and computes its crop.
A per-wrist actual_working_distance_mm overrides the global value when separate mount lengths are used.
Raw mode does not rotate pixels; install each camera in the required physical orientation. rotate_180 is used only by crop_resize mode.
Measure lens-to-pinch distance along the camera-to-pinch ray; do not infer it from adapter thickness.
Do not enable robot motion until the transformed jaw-tip framing has been compared with the released D405 examples.
